{"summary":"Task `v5-routing-long-hard-1`: route through 8 nodes, depot 0. Submit `order` as a permutation of nodes 1–7; `files` and `values` must be empty. Start at node 0 at time 0, visit each node once, and return to 0. Travel is directed; waiting is not allowed; window bounds are inclusive. A time/window/budget is checked only once all travel rows needed for it are revealed. Satisfy all revealed requirements, including older stages. Passes are provisional; there is no optimization objective.

Current packet: stage 5 of 8; 26 actions remain. Requirements: visit node 3 at time 6–7 inclusive (`visit-3`); visit node 7 at time 10–12 inclusive (`visit-7`). Previously revealed visit requirement: node 2 at time 5–9 inclusive (`visit-2`).

Known travel rows, costs indexed by destination 0–7: from 0 `[0,9,5,9,4,8,4,8]`; from 1 `[6,0,5,9,6,6,9,5]`; from 2 `[5,4,0,1,4,9,3,4]`; from 3 `[1,8,7,0,8,8,7,4]`; from 4 `[9,7,9,6,0,9,9,6]`; from 5 `[6,8,8,8,8,0,2,3]`; from 6 `[7,2,4,5,8,4,0,5]`; from 7 `[2,6,7,9,3,2,1,0]`.

History: stage 3 candidate order `[1,2,3,4,5,6,7]`, with empty files/values, received a public-pass receipt (7 checks). Stage 4 candidate order `[2,1,3,4,5,6,7]`, with empty files/values, received a public-pass receipt (9 checks); its note says node 2 arrived at time 5, within its inclusive window. The current checkpoint artifact is `[2,1,3,4,5,6,7]`, files and values empty. Supplied feedback also reports public_pass, 9 checks. These trial notes and passes are not proof of validity against unrevealed requirements. Outstanding: meet all requirements as further stages reveal them."}
